caption: Works on any collection, not just $List$
An atom has no parts, so its length is 0
Of a matrix, the number of rows
A $Set$ holds each element once, so a repeated element counts once
Any expression: the number of terms in a sum
The number of arguments of a call, counting only the top level
A symbol such as $\pi$ is an atom, of length 0
A lazy [[Range]] is counted without being materialised
